claims: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning using multi-layered artificial neural networks to mimic human brain learning.
Deep learning automatically extracts complex patterns from large-scale, unstructured data (images, text, audio).
Neural networks are computational models composed of input, multiple hidden, and output layers to process data.
Representation learning is the ability of algorithms to automatically discover representations needed for feature detection.
"Deep" refers to many layers, often hundreds, allowing for hierarchical learning.
Deep learning training uses backpropagation and vast datasets to minimize error.
Deep learning training requires significant GPU computing power.
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are specialized in image recognition and computer vision.
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) / LSTM are designed for sequential data, such as natural language or time series.
Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) consist of two networks (generator/discriminator) competing to create realistic new data.
Feedforward Neural Networks (FNNs) have direct flow of data from input to output.
Feedforward Neural Networks (FNNs) are often used in simple MLPs.
Deep learning learns features directly from raw data.
Deep learning is used for facial recognition.
Deep learning is used for object detection in photos.
Deep learning is used for language translation.
Deep learning is used for intelligent voice assistants.
Deep learning is used for self-driving cars.
Deep learning is used for creating images from prompts.
Deep learning is used for creating text from prompts.
